006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyDefinition;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IFieldDefinition;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IFlagDefinition;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
013
014import java.util.List;
015import java.util.function.Supplier;
016
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
018
019/**
020 * A set of constraints targeting a {@link IFlagDefinition} based on a target
021 * Metapath expression.
022 */
023public class FlagTargetedConstraints
024    extends AbstractTargetedConstraints<IValueConstrained> {
025
026  /**
027   * Construct a new set of targeted constraints.
028   *
029   * @param source
030   *          information about the resource the constraints were sources from
031   * @param targets
032   *          a supplier to get the Metapath expressions that can be used to find
033   *          matching targets
034   * @param constraints
035   *          the constraints to apply to matching targets
036   */
037  public FlagTargetedConstraints(
038      @NonNull ISource source,
039      @NonNull Supplier<List<IMetapathExpression>> targets,
040      @NonNull IValueConstrained constraints) {
041    super(source, targets, constraints);
042  }
043
044  @Override
045  public void target(@NonNull IFlagDefinition definition) {
046    applyTo(definition);
047  }
048
049  @Override
050  public void target(@NonNull IFieldDefinition definition) {
051    wrongDefinitionTypeTargeted(definition);
052  }
053
054  @Override
055  public void target(@NonNull IAssemblyDefinition definition) {
056    wrongDefinitionTypeTargeted(definition);
057  }
058}
